title: Uniformly heated long cylinder, axisymmetric (r, z): parabolic temperature and thermal stress (analytic)
description:
The heated_cylinder_thermal_stress rod as an axisymmetric (r, z) slice: heat and solid_mechanics both with geometry axisymmetric (x = r, the axis is x_lo; y = z). A thin slice (4 cells) of a long solid rod (radius b, 64 cells) with a uniform heat source q, the surface r = b held at T_amb (temperature on x_hi), the slice faces insulated (z-uniform temperature). heat_solid_thermal_strain hands T - T_amb to the solid; rollers on y_lo / y_hi hold u_z = 0 (a long rod with clamped ends: eps_zz = 0, plane strain along the axis), u_r = 0 on the axis is automatic, the surface is free. No staircase: the rod surface is the domain edge.
Analytic (as the plane-strain cross-section model): theta = T - T_amb = q (b^2 - r^2) / (4 k); with C = E alpha q / (16 k (1 - nu)): sigma_r = -C (b^2 - r^2), sigma_theta = -C (b^2 - 3 r^2), axial sigma_z = nu (sigma_r + sigma_theta) - E alpha theta; u_r = (1 + nu) alpha / (1 - nu) * theta0 r (3 - 2 nu - r^2 / b^2) / 4, theta0 = q b^2 / (4 k). The axial roller force is the whole-ring integral of sigma_z: -pi E alpha theta0 b^2 / 2 (the nu term integrates to 0).
Outputs in (r, z): stress_xx = sigma_r, stress_yy = the axial sigma_z, stress_zz = the hoop sigma_theta, u_x = u_r. The finite-volume heat solve is exact up to a uniform offset q dx^2 / (16 k) (the half-cell surface conductance), ~6e-5 of theta0.
Line profile tab: T_radial, sigma_r, sigma_theta, sigma_z and u_radial along r at the first cell row, centre to the last cell; expected agreement well below 1 % of each curve's range.
Derived values tab: dT_centre, srr_centre / stt_centre (-C b^2 = -6.25 MPa on the axis), szz_centre (axial), stt_surface (hoop tension at the last cell centre), ux_peak (the interior maximum of u_r) and F_axial_top (whole-ring roller force in N) with their references.

parameters.name: q_vol
parameters.description: uniform volumetric heat source in the rod in W/m^3

parameters.name: k_rod
parameters.description: thermal conductivity of the rod in W/(m K)

parameters.name: E_rod
parameters.description: Young's modulus of the rod in Pa

parameters.name: alpha_rod
parameters.description: thermal expansion coefficient of the rod in 1/K

parameters.name: T_amb
parameters.description: surface temperature = heat T0 = stress-free temperature in K

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (64 cells per radius)

parameters.name: H_slice
parameters.description: axial height of the slice (fields are z-uniform)

parameters.name: y_line
parameters.description: height of the radial line (first cell row centre)

parameters.name: theta0
parameters.description: analytic centre rise in K (25 K)

parameters.name: C_stress
parameters.description: thermal stress coefficient C in Pa/m^2 (C b^2 = 6.25 MPa)

parameters.name: r_last
parameters.description: centre radius of the outermost cell
